title: The Microsoft AI Stack for .NET
description: A living presentation powered by AI agents, real-time polls, and the full Microsoft AI stack for .NET.

topics.title: Microsoft.Extensions.AI
topics.description: The abstraction layer for AI in .NET - IChatClient, IEmbeddingGenerator, and the ChatClientBuilder middleware pipeline.
talkingPoints: Why abstractions matter: swap Ollama for any LLM with one line
IChatClient: the universal chat interface
IEmbeddingGenerator: turn text into vectors
ChatClientBuilder pipeline: add logging, caching, retries, function calling
AIFunctionFactory: expose any C# method as an AI tool

pollPrompts.context: Audience has just learned about IChatClient abstraction
pollPrompts.hint: Ask about which abstraction benefit resonates most

topics.title: Data Ingestion & Vector Search
topics.description: Feeding the brain - markdown documents flow through chunking, enrichment, and embedding into a vector store for semantic search.
talkingPoints: RAG pattern: Retrieval-Augmented Generation explained
Pipeline: read → chunk → enrich (summary, keywords) → embed → store
IVectorStoreRecordCollection: type-safe vector records
Semantic search vs keyword search
The snowball effect: each segment adds more knowledge

pollPrompts.hint: Ask about which RAG component they find most valuable

topics.title: Agent Framework
topics.description: Specialized AI agents with tools and multi-agent workflows that collaborate to generate polls, analyze responses, and curate knowledge.
talkingPoints: What makes an agent different from a simple LLM call
SurveyArchitect: generates context-aware polls using search_knowledge
ResponseAnalyst: interprets results and stores insights
KnowledgeCurator: RAG specialist combining local + external knowledge
Multi-agent workflows: agents collaborating in sequence

pollPrompts.context: Audience has seen agent tool use
pollPrompts.hint: Ask about which agent role they find most interesting

topics.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
topics.description: The bridge between AI and tools - our app exposes 10 MCP tools so any AI client can query session data, search knowledge, and generate summaries.
talkingPoints: MCP: the USB-C of AI integrations
Our app as MCP server: 10 tools at /mcp
Our app as MCP client: querying Microsoft Learn docs
StreamableHTTP transport: server-sent events for streaming
Any MCP client can now use our session data

pollPrompts.hint: Ask about the most valuable MCP use case they can imagine

topics.title: The Living Presentation Closer
topics.description: The grand finale - all six technologies fire in sequence as we generate a comprehensive session summary live on stage.
talkingPoints: The cascade: Copilot → MCP → Agents → RAG → Vector Store → AI abstractions
Every poll, question, and insight feeds the final summary
The snowball effect at maximum: richest context of the session
One command. Six technologies. Working together.
This presentation was itself the demo

pollPrompts.context: Full session completed - audience has seen all technologies
pollPrompts.hint: Ask which technology they're most excited to use in their own projects

title: .NET 10 Deep Dive
description: Explore C# 14 features, performance improvements, and the new runtime capabilities shipping in .NET 10.

topics.title: C# 14 New Features
topics.description: Field access in auto-properties, first-class spans, extension members, and the new params collections overhaul.
talkingPoints: field keyword: access the backing field from auto-property accessors
First-class Span<T>: pass spans directly without explicit casts
Extension members: add properties, indexers, and static members to any type
params collections: works with IEnumerable<T>, Span<T>, and custom types
Implicit indexer access in object initializers
Partial properties and partial indexers

pollPrompts.context: Audience has seen the field keyword and extension members
pollPrompts.hint: Ask which C# 14 feature they are most excited to use

topics.title: Performance Improvements
topics.description: JIT enhancements, SIMD vectorisation, runtime startup time, and what the .NET 10 benchmarks actually show.
talkingPoints: Dynamic PGO is now on by default and smarter than ever
AVX-512 auto-vectorisation for numeric workloads
Ahead-of-time publication: native AOT on server and mobile
Startup time improvements in the new Blazor WASM runtime
GC: region-based heap and lower pause times
BenchmarkDotNet: measuring what actually matters

pollPrompts.context: Audience understands JIT and GC basics
pollPrompts.hint: Ask about which performance area matters most to their projects

topics.title: ASP.NET Core 10
topics.description: OpenAPI 3.1 built-in, minimal-API route groups, Blazor hybrid improvements, and the new Identity v3.
talkingPoints: Built-in OpenAPI 3.1 document generation - no more Swashbuckle
Minimal API route groups with filters and middleware
Blazor: new static SSR streaming mode, enhanced forms
Identity v3: passkey support out of the box
SignalR: long-running Hub methods and back-pressure
New IHostedLifecycleService for fine-grained startup/shutdown

pollPrompts.context: Audience builds web APIs or Blazor apps
pollPrompts.hint: Ask which ASP.NET Core 10 feature they will adopt first

topics.title: New Runtime & Library APIs
topics.description: Tensor<T>, LINQ improvements, TimeProvider everywhere, and the new System.Text.Json source-gen defaults.
talkingPoints: System.Numerics.Tensors: Tensor<T> for AI and ML workloads
LINQ: CountBy, AggregateBy, Index - cleaner aggregations
TimeProvider: testable time abstraction is now everywhere in the BCL
System.Text.Json: AOT-first, JsonSchemaExporter for AI tool schemas
Cryptography: post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA)
System.IO.Compression: Zstandard (zstd) support

pollPrompts.context: Audience has heard about Tensor<T> and new LINQ operators
pollPrompts.hint: Ask which new API they plan to use soonest

topics.title: Developer Tooling & SDK
topics.description: SDK workload improvements, dotnet run with project detection, the new build output layout, and .NET Aspire 9.
talkingPoints: dotnet run: smarter project and launch-profile detection
New build output layout: artifacts/ folder at solution root
Hot reload: wider coverage including interfaces and generics
.NET Aspire 9: dashboard redesign, Azure deployment wizard
NuGet v3 client: faster restore and package pruning
Visual Studio 2022 copilot integration improvements

title: Cloud-Native Patterns with .NET
description: Containers, service mesh, observability, and resilience patterns for building cloud-native .NET applications.

topics.title: Containers & Kubernetes
topics.description: Building minimal .NET container images, Dockerfile best practices, distroless base images, and deploying to AKS.
talkingPoints: Why container size matters: chiseled Ubuntu vs mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet
SDK-managed container builds: dotnet publish --os linux and container properties in csproj
Multi-stage Dockerfiles for build isolation
Non-root containers and security context in Kubernetes
AKS: managed node pools, auto-scaling, and the Azure CNI overlay
Helm vs Kustomize: choosing the right templating approach

pollPrompts.context: Audience has seen container build options
pollPrompts.hint: Ask which container deployment target they use most

topics.title: Service Mesh & Communication
topics.description: mTLS, traffic management, and observability with Istio, Linkerd, and the DAPR building blocks.
talkingPoints: What a service mesh actually does: proxy sidecar vs eBPF
mTLS everywhere: zero-trust network within the cluster
Traffic management: canary, blue-green, and circuit breaking
DAPR: portable building blocks for state, pub/sub, bindings, and secrets
gRPC vs HTTP/2 for internal service communication
Service mesh overhead: latency and CPU cost trade-offs

pollPrompts.hint: Ask about their biggest inter-service communication pain point

topics.title: Observability with OpenTelemetry
topics.description: Traces, metrics, and logs flowing through the OpenTelemetry SDK into Prometheus, Grafana, and Jaeger.
talkingPoints: The three pillars: traces, metrics, logs - and why all three matter
OpenTelemetry .NET SDK: AddOpenTelemetry() and the OTLP exporter
Activity API: adding custom spans and baggage to traces
System.Diagnostics.Metrics: instruments, histograms, and exemplars
ILogger + OpenTelemetry: correlation IDs automatically in log output
.NET Aspire dashboard: OTLP ingestion out of the box for local dev

pollPrompts.hint: Ask which observability pillar they invest in least today

topics.title: Resilience Patterns
topics.description: Retry, circuit breaker, timeout, hedging, and rate limiting with Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience and Polly v8.
talkingPoints: Transient fault handling: why retry alone is not enough
AddStandardResilienceHandler(): the sensible default pipeline
Circuit breaker: fail fast and let downstream services recover
Hedging: send duplicate requests to the fastest responder
Chaos engineering with Simmy: inject faults in tests
Rate limiting middleware: fixed window, sliding window, token bucket

pollPrompts.context: Audience understands why services fail transiently
pollPrompts.hint: Ask which resilience pattern they have actually needed in production

topics.title: GitOps & CI/CD Pipelines
topics.description: GitHub Actions, Flux CD, container image promotion across environments, and shift-left security scanning.
talkingPoints: GitOps: the cluster always matches what's in the repo
Flux CD: image automation and Helm release reconciliation
GitHub Actions: build, test, push image, open PR - all automated
Environment promotion: dev → staging → production via branch policies
Container signing with Sigstore Cosign and image verification in Kubernetes
SBOM generation with dotnet workload install wasm-tools and NuGet audit
